title: Greek Roasted Potato Wedges
description: A delicious Greek-inspired side dish made with crispy roasted potato wedges, perfect for any meal. This recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the simplicity of roasted potatoes.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-quality potatoes for the best results

ingredients.name: Greek Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a store-bought or homemade Greek seasoning blend

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use sea salt for a more authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Juicy Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice adds brightness to the dish

instructions: Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and place them on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with Greek seasoning, salt, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Toss the potatoes to coat them evenly with the seasonings.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
